instruction: UV Cross-Seam Unwrap `scene.blend` contains mesh `Cube` with no UV layer and no seams. Mark a seam layout that unfolds the cube into a cross-style unwrap, unwrap it with the Angle-Based method, pack the islands, and save the scene as `answer.blend`. Requirements: `Cube` must end up with at least one UV layer; between 5 and 9 edges must be marked as seams; all UV coordinates must lie within `[0,1]^2` within epsilon `0.01`; the UV bounding box must span at least `0.60` in one dimension and `0.40` in the other; UV overlap must remain below 1% on the required grid test; and the island count must be between 1 and 6.
source: Lévy, Petitjean, Ray, Maillot 2002 — "Least Squares Conformal Maps for Automatic Texture Atlas Generation", SIGGRAPH
